summary: Steep west kerb on Princess Street with two houses 8 m away.
reasons: Narrow street, houses close all round

best_section.where: West kerb of Princess Street, just north of the cross street

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes 8 m away at 3 m and 15 m along; apartments 13 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park along the kerb but the lane is narrow, with houses and fences directly behind.
drivers.traffic: Residential through street towards the station; moderate traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park here; only a weekday 7-9am no-parking sign.

sun_shade: Mostly open; some tree shade from the west at the north end.
